title: One Thing Leads to Another: The Essentials of Time Series Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.13430v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time series causal discovery --- the process of detecting causation between time series --- has its roots in signal processing research from over a half century ago. It has since received active and widespread interest, evolving into different forms across domains such as statistics, dynamical systems and machine learning. Entering this fragmented and constantly evolving research landscape can be daunting. This tutorial provides a unified overview of time series causal discovery across research communities. We introduce the key principles invoked by modern discovery methods, and we discuss their limitations and assumptions. We also discuss how discovery methods are evaluated, benchmarked and fine-tuned. We further discuss how causal discovery for time series is becoming crucial for downstream tasks in agriculture and Earth science, in healthcare, and in artificial intelligence systems. translated_title: 一因导一果：时间序列因果发现的核心要点
translated_abstract: 时间序列因果发现——即检测时间序列之间因果关系的过程——起源于半个多世纪前的信号处理研究。此后，它一直受到积极而广泛的关注，并在统计学、动力系统和机器学习等领域演化出不同的形式。进入这个碎片化且不断发展的研究领域可能令人望而生畏。本教程为跨研究社区的时间序列因果发现提供了统一的概述。我们介绍了现代发现方法所采用的关键原理，并讨论了它们的局限性和假设。我们还讨论了如何对发现方法进行评估、基准测试和微调。我们进一步讨论了时间序列因果发现如何在农业与地球科学、医疗保健以及人工智能系统的下游任务中变得至关重要。我们相信本教程将作为一个有价值的……
tldr: 本教程论文首次为统计学、动力系统和机器学习等不同研究社区的时间序列因果发现方法提供了统一概述，系统介绍了其关键原理、局限性、假设、评估基准方法以及在农业、地球科学、医疗保健和人工智能系统等下游任务中的重要性。
en_tdlr: This tutorial provides a unified overview of time series causal discovery across research communities in statistics, dynamical systems, and machine learning, introducing key principles, limitations, assumptions, evaluation benchmarks, and its growing importance for downstream applications in agriculture, Earth science, healthcare, and AI systems.
